title: Constraints on the gravitational potential from DESI DR2 BAO and its implications for the local void scenario
efc_relevance: Tests the local-void H0 explanation against DESI DR2 BAO + BBN + CMB. EFC posits an entropic-flow alternative rather than a void; the paper's posterior on the local potential profile provides a direct contrast template for EFC's L2 entropic-flow contribution to the local E(z) shape (arXiv:2605.05691 framing).
ledger_action: Add to Gap Analysis as H0-mechanism contrast row; cross-reference framework:Timescape-Wiltshire2007, arXiv:2605.05454 (Cosmicflows-4++ backreaction) and arXiv:2605.05691; required follow-up: EFC prediction for the local gravitational-potential profile on 30–300 Mpc/h scales.
